notes: The Rust EXPLICIT_UNSUPPORTED_CLI_SURFACES and ADDITIONAL_UNSUPPORTED_CLI_SURFACES registries are authoritative. Every unsupported entry returns a machine-visible hard error; unregistered command strings are rejected at runtime. Parser, schema, golden-fixture, transport, marker-file, or generated-template presence is not treated as product implementation. v1.2.0-beta.5 hardens E2/E3: Agent verifies authorization.bound_action against payload_hash before side effects (including cancel); mutating MCP tools require idempotency_key; command env overlays are bounded and hash-bound; DeviceRoom redelivers durable pending on Agent ready; binary reads use standard Base64 with byte next_offset cursors; durable mcp_operations enforce per-tenant row/byte/TTL quotas with idempotency tombstones that are never evicted under capacity before the 30-day window; accepted claims store a crash-safe dispatch outbox so post-claim/pre-route Worker death redelivers the bound body; Agent completed-reply and op-journal durable state are byte/count capped; directory list cursors bind (name,path). Real binary × local Wrangler/workerd proof covers write/read/command+env, resume, idempotent non-rerun, bound cancel, binary range read, and missing-key reject via scripts/tests/test_v12_e2_e9_workerd_loopback.py. Prior beta.4 added server payload_hash, durable D1 action fields, bounded command streaming, and process-tree cancel. CLI exec --device and session open <device> remain explicit hard errors (no local fallback). Workspace CRUD, approval-watch, cloud PTY sessions, profile product surfaces, broker mint authority, and transfer remain unsupported. Live-account E2E (E10) remains open. v1.1.0 integrates onboarding (setup, doctor, user-level service lifecycle: Windows current-user Scheduled Task ONLOGON, macOS LaunchAgent, Linux systemd --user) with signed distribution/update. These service surfaces are distinct from the privileged broker, which remains unsupported for install/uninstall. Privileged broker install/uninstall are side-effect-free unsupported operations until a secure mint authority exists; privileged broker status reports fail-closed metadata only. Update surfaces are production-wired against official GitHub Releases with embedded minisign verification; automatic network checks remain off by default.
